//: The socket service is server.js plus its package manifest - nothing else.
Left unconfigured, nodemon watches the whole spa/ tree for js/mjs/json, so an SPA
rebuild (spa/dist/**) restarts the chat server and disconnects every connected client.
Runtime upload directories are excluded for the same reason: user data changing must
never restart a live service. This is the DEVELOPMENT watcher only - beta and
production run `npm start`, which does not watch at all.
